name: Yoshioka Maki
source: World history teacher at Seishuu Academy. Old friends with Yuuri. Exudes an air of professionalism, and maturity. As a member of a branch family in relation to the Kamiyama household, she makes it her duty to protect Yuuri.
translation: 青修学园的世界史教师。她与优里是老朋友。她散发出专业而成熟的气质。作为神山家的旁支，她把保护优里视为自己的职责。
